title: Primitives
description: Reusable scalar formats. Timestamps are ISO-8601; anything stored in Postgres is UTC with the originating IANA timezone kept alongside when it matters.

Uuid.title: Uuid
Uuid.description: UUID, serialised in lowercase canonical form. Expressed as `format: uuid` alone rather than as a pattern as well: generators map the format onto a real UUID type whose canonical serialisation is already lowercase, whereas a pattern beside it forces the value back to a bare string.

Timestamp.title: Timestamp
Timestamp.description: ISO-8601 instant with an explicit offset, e.g. 2026-09-17T08:30:00Z.

Locale.title: Locale
Locale.description: BCP-47 language tag, e.g. th-TH or en-GB.

Timezone.title: Timezone
Timezone.description: IANA time zone identifier, e.g. Asia/Bangkok. Validated against the tz database at the boundary, not by pattern alone.

MessageKey.title: MessageKey
MessageKey.description: i18n key the web app resolves. Servers never send pre-translated progress copy.
